reason: Integrates Qwen-MM-Plugins into DeepSeek Harness to provide multimodal media and document analysis, external vision and search services, attachment bridging, and optional video, 3D, and CAD tools.

summaries.zh: 将 Qwen-MM-Plugins 集成到 DeepSeek Harness，为文本模型提供图像、视频和文档理解，以及视觉、搜索和相关媒体工具。
summaries.en: Integrates Qwen-MM-Plugins with DeepSeek Harness to provide image, video, and document understanding along with vision, search, and related media tools.

capabilities: Reads and analyzes images, videos, documents, code, and data through MCP tools
Uses cloud vision, OCR, and speech recognition APIs requiring provider credentials
Performs web and image search through external search providers
May invoke video editing, Blender, FreeCAD, Chromium, and other local tools
Writes uploaded image attachments to local plugin storage
